decisions.agreement: Important care/contact destinations should be recognisable as a coherent directory.
decisions.conflict: Ota's icon toolbar and Beethoven's oversized Latin typography are different treatments; neither dictates this clinic's shape or fonts.
decisions.change: Derive four named care shortcuts from the existing homepage content; keep native details, Escape return and outside dismissal. Anchor the expanded menu to the header.
decisions.revision: A first render clipped the menu at 375 (x=-97); corrected, then reduced the header booking width so 320 stays on one row.

decisions.agreement: A real subject/use scene and its associated explanation form a meaningful reading unit.
decisions.conflict: Commerce, 3D, black/orange styling, bitmap prose and identical cards do not serve the retained clinic brand or budgets.
decisions.change: Keep the owned room image, distinguish room selection from a coherent four-part visit explanation, restore the existing examination text verbatim and use compact run-in mobile paragraphs.
decisions.revision: The first vertical mobile list was too long; the next render preserves all four statements with less repeated vertical separation.

decisions.agreement: Type, relative emphasis and stable state feedback must work together.
decisions.conflict: Awarded expressive media does not override native usability, the owner-rejected bright controls, local fonts or reduced motion.
decisions.change: Keep restrained action surfaces and small dots; remove the selected environment's green block, use the same directional SVG vocabulary in the footer, and provide a cancellable menu transition only in normal motion.
